kit-connect.title: More ways to connect
kit-connect.monitors.title: Pages you watch
kit-connect.monitors.line: Chausar looks at a public page once an hour, as itself, and tells you on Today when it changes.
kit-connect.monitors.urlHint: A public page. Sites whose terms bar automated reading are refused.
kit-connect.monitors.selector: The part that shows the price
kit-connect.monitors.selectorHint: A tag, an #id or a .class, such as #price.
kit-connect.monitors.rupeesHint: Rupees, as you would write them.
kit-connect.mail.title: Mail files
kit-connect.mail.line: No mailbox connected? Export the mails as .eml or .mbox files and import them here. Each message is screened first.
kit-connect.mail.tooBig: This file is too big for the desktop app. Export a smaller folder, under 1.4 MB.
kit-connect.apps.title: Apps on this computer
kit-connect.apps.line: Chausar can use apps you installed yourself, through their command line. Anything that changes something runs only as the exact command you approve.
kit-connect.webhook.title: Your n8n or Make
kit-connect.webhook.line: Already use n8n or Make? Paste a webhook address. Chausar sends an item there only after you approve that exact item.
kit-connect.webhook.urlHint: Kept only while the app is open, like a key.
kit-connect.webhook.test: The test item, sent exactly as shown:
kit-connect.speech.title: Speech from text
kit-connect.speech.line: Turn text into speech on your own provider key, after a quote, with a licensed or consented voice.
kit-connect.code.FETCH_POLICY_REFUSED: This site's terms don't allow automated reading. Paste the text instead.
kit-connect.code.ROBOTS_REFUSED: This site asks robots not to read that page.
kit-connect.code.NET_ADDRESS_REFUSED: This address points inside your computer or your network, so Chausar will not open it.
kit-connect.code.MONITOR_LIMIT: You watch 20 pages already. Stop watching one first.
kit-connect.code.MAIL_FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is over 25 MB. Export a smaller folder.
kit-connect.code.MAIL_FILE_UNREADABLE: Import a mail file: one message as .eml, or many as .mbox.
kit-connect.code.WEBHOOK_REFUSED: Your webhook refused the test item, so the address was not kept.
kit-connect.code.INVALID_AMOUNT: Type a positive amount in rupees, like 1200.50.
kit-connect.code.TIER_UNAVAILABLE: This works in the desktop app.
